dormitories.name: Tuas View Lodge
dormitories.summary: A 4,200-bed purpose-built dormitory serving the Tuas industrial belt, with dedicated recreation decks and on-site medical support.
writeup: Tuas View Lodge was purpose-built to house workers from the surrounding marine and heavy industrial cluster, with direct shuttle access to major yards along Tuas South Avenue.
Every block is organised around a central recreation courtyard, with cross-ventilated rooms, dedicated cooking decks, and a 24-hour on-site management office.
The dormitory operates under a structured welfare framework, with regular facility audits and a resident feedback channel managed directly by our operations team.

dormitories.name: Senoko Crescent Dormitory
dormitories.summary: A newer-generation dormitory in the north, built around larger communal spaces and improved room ventilation standards.
writeup: Senoko Crescent Dormitory opened in 2021 and reflects the latest generation of purpose-built worker housing, with wider corridors, larger windows and upgraded fire-safety systems throughout.
The site sits close to the Senoko industrial estate and offers scheduled shuttle routes to nearby manufacturing and logistics employers.
A dedicated welfare officer is based on site to coordinate resident matters, medical referrals and dormitory administration.

dormitories.name: Jurong Central Block
dormitories.summary: One of our earlier developments, fully upgraded in 2023 with new kitchen decks and expanded recreation space.
writeup: Jurong Central Block has housed workers from the surrounding port and processing industries since 2017, and underwent a full facilities upgrade in 2023.
The refurbishment added a second recreation deck, expanded wet-kitchen capacity, and replaced all room lighting and ventilation fittings.
Its location places most major Jurong-area worksites within a short shuttle ride, reducing daily commute time for residents.
